VERDICT.comparison_basis: equal achieved budget per seed (1840 / 2036 / 2160 calls), both arms truncated to the smaller. Ledgers are append-only in charge order, so a prefix is exactly 'what this arm had spent by call N'.

my_hypothesis_was_WRONG.predicted: the control found 0 against 2.86 expected because it re-expands one state on ~98% of decisions and therefore buys fewer effective independent draws; a spread-out searcher should find more
my_hypothesis_was_WRONG.observed: novelty-exploration spreads far more -- 31/40 distinct starts against 1/40, 0.84 scaffolds per pick against 0.21 -- and found exactly as many actives: zero. It also moved best-JNK3 LESS (0.13 vs 0.21 on seed 100) and had lower early HV on all three seeds.
my_hypothesis_was_WRONG.status: REFUTED. Concentration was not what suppressed discovery.

the_stronger_finding_this_exposes.observation: pooled across both arms and three seeds, ~4.1 chance actives were expected and ZERO were found. p(0 | lambda=4.1) = 0.017.
the_stronger_finding_this_exposes.reading: R_theta-edit search from a random-120 start appears WORSE than uniform random ZINC sampling at reaching jnk3 >= 0.3, for both policies. The neighbourhood of a random drug-like molecule is active-poorer than a fresh random draw.
the_stronger_finding_this_exposes.most_likely_mechanism_untested: the base rate was measured on ZINC molecules; successors are edited molecules that may leave the drug-like manifold the JNK3 oracle was fit on. That would depress activity for reasons of distribution rather than of search.
the_stronger_finding_this_exposes.consistent_with: the earlier finding that Graph-GA does not reliably beat uniform random sampling (4/8 seeds)

VERDICT.recommendation: DO NOT spend the ~$0.26 to finish the three novelty arms. The remaining 340-660 calls per arm expect ~0.2 further chance actives and cannot change the reading.
